item: Servo-rail bulk capacitor 1000 uF >=16 V low-ESR
origin_policy: Commodity; qualify non-PRC alternate for flight lot
notes: Fitted at the servo connector, not at the supply. Sized by C = I*dt/dV against the 1.47 A XL330 stall figure: 1000 uF covers about 170 us of stall inrush within 0.25 V. Bulk capacitance cannot hold a sustained stall (1 ms within 0.25 V would need 5880 uF) - the dedicated servo rail does that. 16 V part on a 5 V rail is a 3.2x voltage derate. Resize from the measured transient before flight. Companion controller-side hold-up island (Schottky + 470 uF) is conditional: do not order it before the rail-transient scope capture in docs/electrical-evidence.md
